## Rule

Path-A byte-equal to LIVE. The active grid is at most 5x5 and contains color 5 plus one other color k. LIVE writes k at color-5 cells, background at other active cells, and all-zero padding outside the active grid. This task is hidden-fragile enough that exact LIVE parity is the safe basis.

## Algorithm sketch

Existing compact formulation: extract k from per-channel presence with `ReduceMax(input,[2,3])` + `Einsum` using weights `[0,1,2,3,4,0,6,7,8,9]`; build 5x5 `is_color5` and `active` masks with negpad 1x1 Convs; form a u8 5x5 color-index canvas (`k`, `0`, or sentinel `10`); expand to one-hot at 5x5 and final `Pad(BOOL,false)` to the fixed 30x30 output.

Current team-best is 1,296 from the #67 free-output Equal-tail candidate. Its dominant charge was the padded u8 `[1,1,30,30]` index canvas (900 B). The 2026-06-11 candidate applies #81: expand the one-hot while still 5x5 (`BOOL [1,10,5,5]` = 250 B) and make the final Pad the uncharged output node.
